title: MHP's platform slot is SAP, and its recorded verticals narrow to automotive and manufacturing
content:
MHP's tool field records one platform, SAP, against two verticals, automotive and manufacturing. That is a clear reading for a rescore that weighs slot occupancy: the platform slot is filled, and it is filled by the vendor whose ecosystem defines how German automotive and manufacturing back offices are built.

The narrowness cuts both ways. A firm concentrated on one platform and two adjacent sectors is easy to characterise and easy to exclude, but it also has no second slot in which a different kind of component could sit without touching the SAP practice.

As with the other carried-over rows, the tier is mechanical rather than evidenced: a provisional v2 tail entry, rescored on size and slot occupancy, never scored on v3, with the OSS-portfolio screen the flag asks for still outstanding.
